text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 23,960.6, up 0.63% for the day and 5.56% over the past five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 1.1% (5‑day gain 4.79%). Advances outpaced declines with 395 stocks up versus 94 down, giving a breadth score of 44.4 in a neutral zone. The move was fairly broad, as 40.9% of stocks stayed above their 20‑day average and 35.6% above the 200‑day average.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding INR 6,836.81 crore today and a five‑day total of INR 15,309.51 crore, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold INR 3,678.85 crore. The options market shows a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 1.93 for Nifty, indicating more put interest, with the max‑pain level at 23,700 and a call wall at 23,850. Bank Nifty’s PCR is 0.97, call and put walls both near 58,000, suggesting balanced sentiment. Leading sectors were Pharma, Infrastructure and Oil & Gas; IT and Private Bank stocks were weakening.

Watch the Nifty range of 23,801‑23,820 and the key support at 23,285 (S1). If the index holds above the 23,700 put wall, next focus will be the 23,562 pivot and the 24,327 resistance near the 200‑day average. Global cues such as US mid‑term election outcomes and crude price moves could influence the next session.
